c74object.name: mqtt.homie.device
c74object.digest: Present Max as a Homie device
c74object.description: Publishes a Homie 5 device: its state, its description and property values, and receives commands for settable properties.

discussion.p: Homie is a convention for devices on MQTT. A device lives at {domain}/5/{device-id}; its $state is init, ready, disconnected, sleeping or lost, and its $description is a JSON document of nodes and their properties, each with a datatype.

Send the description as a dictionary, for example from a dict: {"name": "...", "nodes": {"light": {"properties": {"level": {"datatype": "integer", "format": "0:100", "settable": true}}}}}. The homie and version fields are filled in.

On each connection the device publishes init, its description, its retained values and ready, and listens to broadcasts of its domain. If the connection drops, the broker publishes lost (the last will). A client has one Homie device; adding or changing it reconnects the client, since the last will belongs to the connection.
Values are checked against the property: datatype, and range from format. Properties are retained (QoS 2) unless "retained": false, which streams them at QoS 0.
IDs may only contain a-z, 0-9 and hyphens.

objarg.name: client
objarg.digest: Name of the mqtt.client to use

method.name: value
method.description: Integers, floats, 1/0 for booleans, symbols for strings and enums, a color type and its values for colors (e.g. rgb 255 0 0), text for datetime (ISO 8601) and duration (e.g. PT5M), a dictionary for json. Numbers are rounded to the step in the property's format, then checked against its range.

method.name: dictionary
method.description: The $description document. Changing it while ready publishes init, the new description and ready.

method.name: alert
method.description: A retained alert at $alert/{id}. Without text, removes the alert.

method.name: log
method.description: Level debug, info, warn, error or fatal, not retained. mqtt.homie.controller reports it on its dumpout.

attribute.name: domain
attribute.description: The first topic level, homie by default.

entry.name: left outlet
entry.description: Commands from controllers for settable properties: node, property and value. Send the accepted value back with value.

entry.name: right outlet
entry.description: Dumpout: state with each state the device publishes (init, ready, sleeping, disconnected); broadcast with the subtopic and text of a controller broadcast to the domain; error with a text.
